chapters.title: Ram-Ram Sa: A Greeting the Hand Can Make
chapters.label: ch:mw-ram-ram-sa
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, read, say, copy, and write the respectful Marwadi greeting राम-राम सा, and answer it with the same greeting.

payoff.summary: A two-line authentic greeting exchange followed by independent written recall, using only signs and language taught in the chapter.

chapters.title: Aabhaar: Formal Thanks, Two New Signs
chapters.label: ch:mw-aabhaar
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, hear, say, copy, and independently write आभार as a short formal gratitude response.

payoff.summary: A source-attested formal gratitude word built from two new signs and two signs already taught, followed by independent four-skill retrieval.

chapters.title: Haan Sa: A Respectful Yes, Sign by Sign
chapters.label: ch:mw-haan-saa
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, hear, say, copy, and independently write हां सा as a respectful affirmative answer.

payoff.summary: A source-attested polite affirmative built from two tiny script steps and the already-known respect word सा, followed by independently scored four-skill retrieval.

chapters.title: Paani: Hear Water, Then Write It Sign by Sign
chapters.label: ch:mw-paani
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, hear, say, read, and independently write पाणी as the Marwadi word for water.

payoff.summary: A source-attested everyday noun secured by ear before three new signs are isolated, assembled, and retrieved independently in all four skills.
